label.ingredients_text: Stone Ground Whole Corn, Sunflower Oil, Sea Salt
label.summary: This product has some redeeming qualities, but it is noticeably processed.
label.recommended_action: Okay occasionally, but not ideal as a staple.

flag_explanations.title: Seed Oils
flag_explanations.explanation: Industrial seed oils like canola, soybean, and sunflower oil are high in omega-6 fatty acids. Excess omega-6 can promote inflammation when not balanced with omega-3s. Look for olive oil, avocado oil, coconut oil, or butter instead.
flag_explanations.look_for: Olive oil, avocado oil, coconut oil, butter, ghee
